integrity: Proof and supplementary checker report only same-model review. No independent audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic spectrogram slice at one phase-opposition time; does not treat all phases, unequal outer tones, noise, or practical detectability. One closely related 2026 primary paper was accessible by abstract but not by complete full text; possible hidden multi-tone coverage remains a priority risk. Numerical tests supplement, not replace, the proof.
title: Three-stage spectral splitting for phase-opposed Gaussian three-tone measurements
